updates.rationale: The accepted continuum bridge supplies the receiver-curve compactness, finite-support approximation, and rowwise stability machinery needed by this converse program. Less integration work remains, and the program is now a more credible route, though unrelaxed optimized-value convergence is still unresolved.

The submission resolves most of the agenda-setting work around extending finite-grid receiver arguments to a compact continuum and explicitly isolates the remaining zero-margin constraint issue, leaving only limited agenda refinement.

Uniform curve approximation and audited stability remove substantial exploratory work, but a difficult focused search remains for control of active rate-free constraints or another argument establishing the required unrelaxed limiting step. The strengthened branch makes pursuing this residual search somewhat more likely.
